zh: 卡迪夫大学（Cardiff University）成立于1883年，位于英国威尔士首府卡迪夫，是威尔士地区唯一的罗素集团成员校，2005年正式脱离威尔士大学联盟并独立颁发学位。学校在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第181位，研究产出评级为"极高"，全球在校生近3万人，其中国际学生占比超25%。学校在人文、自然、物理、健康、生命和社会科学、工程技术等多个领域拥有卓越的研究与教学实力。
en: Cardiff University, founded in 1883, is located in Cardiff, the capital of Wales, UK. It is the only Welsh member of the Russell Group of research-intensive British universities and became an independent university awarding its own degrees in 2005. Ranked 181st in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university has a "Very High" research output rating, with nearly 30,000 students worldwide, including over 25% international students. It excels in research and teaching across humanities, natural, physical, health, life and social sciences, engineering and technology, and lifelong learning.
